# Everything else must use placeholders (app.example.org, auth.example.org, ...): a generic
# instruction that names a real host gets copied into another installation's config.
# Add a file here only when it documents ORISO's own installation, and give the reason.
# One glob per line; "*" also matches "/". An entry that matches no tracked file fails the check.
